constraints.name: Taj Mahal Friday Closure
constraints.message: The Taj Mahal is closed to general visitors on Fridays for prayers.

constraints.name: Bandipur Night Traffic Ban
constraints.message: Bandipur National Park gates are strictly closed from 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM.

constraints.name: Rohtang Pass Permits & Closure
constraints.message: Rohtang Pass requires a verified permit for vehicles. Passes are limited daily and closed on Tuesdays for maintenance. Seasonal closures apply Nov-May.

constraints.name: Bengaluru-Mysuru Expressway 2W Ban
constraints.message: Motorcycles are officially banned on the Bengaluru-Mysuru Expressway main carriageway. You must use the service roads or alternate highway.
